meta.conservationLaw: γ + η = C (activity + latency = constant at fleet level)

superinstance.ai.name: SuperInstance
superinstance.ai.tagline: Bird's eye view of the fleet. Every ship, every signal.
superinstance.ai.content_angle: Fleet-level observability. Shows all agents (ships), their conservation budgets, inter-agent signals, and the ternary ledger across the entire system. This is the Admiral's view — every ship's wake at once.

activelog.name: ActiveLog
activelog.tagline: Activity tracking that doesn't lie. Every commit, every heartbeat.
activelog.content_angle: The γ in γ + η = C. Activity logs as first-class git commits. Every action is a bottle message — timestamped, signed, mergeable. Tracks what agents actually did, not what they claimed to do.

activeledger.name: ActiveLedger
activeledger.tagline: Accounting where every entry has a commit hash.
activeledger.content_angle: Ternary conservation applied to finance. Every transaction has three proofs (source, sink, witness). The ledger is git-native — rebasing is auditing, merges are settlements. η here is reconciliation latency.

studylog.ai.name: StudyLog
studylog.ai.tagline: Learn in public. Track what you actually retained.
studylog.ai.content_angle: Knowledge as a git graph. Each study session is a commit on a topic branch. Forgetting is a force-push. Review is a rebase. The bottle protocol sends questions between study sessions — agents quiz each other across time.

personallog.ai.name: PersonalLog
personallog.ai.tagline: A journal that commits. Private by default, yours forever.
personallog.ai.content_angle: First-person view of a single agent's inner state. Entries are bottles sealed with timestamps. The conservation law applies as: depth of reflection (γ) vs. time between entries (η). More frequent entries can be shallower; rare ones go deep.

dmlog.ai.name: DMLog
dmlog.ai.tagline: Dungeon Master tools that remember what your players forgot.
dmlog.ai.content_angle: Campaign state as a git repo. Sessions are commits. NPC decisions are bottles — sealed at creation, opened when encountered. The ternary system tracks: player intent (γ), world response (η), and narrative coherence (C).

fishinglog.ai.name: FishingLog
fishinglog.ai.tagline: Log every catch. Learn every pattern. Respect the water.
fishinglog.ai.content_angle: Environmental data as agent signals. Tide, weather, catch — all bottles in the stream. Conservation: time on water (γ) + patience between strikes (η) = the day's story (C). Patterns emerge across seasons like a slow agent coordination.

playerlog.ai.name: PlayerLog
playerlog.ai.tagline: Track your sessions. Find your patterns. Get good.
playerlog.ai.content_angle: Game sessions as commits. Win/loss is a ternary state: you, opponent, meta. The bottle protocol stores clutch plays sealed until复盘 (review). Conservation: mechanical skill (γ) + game sense (η) = MMR (C).

luciddreamer.ai.name: LucidDreamer
luciddreamer.ai.tagline: Dream logs that compile. Wake up with receipts.
luciddreamer.ai.content_angle: Dreams as the most honest agent output — no user prompt, pure latent space. Each dream is a bottle from the unconscious. Conservation: dream vividness (γ) + recall clarity (η) = what you bring back (C). The graph connects recurring symbols across nights.

deckboss.net.name: DeckBoss
deckboss.net.tagline: Maritime operations. Every watch logged, every bearing recorded.
deckboss.net.content_angle: The original bottle protocol — messages in bottles across the sea. Ship logs are the oldest git-native format. Conservation: crew activity (γ) + sea state response time (η) = voyage safety (C). Each vessel is a ship in the fleet, literally.

purplepincher.org.name: PurplePincher
purplepincher.org.tagline: Open source tools and nonprofit infrastructure. Free as in fleet.
purplepincher.org.content_angle: The commons of the fleet. Open-source releases are bottles sent to everyone. Conservation: contributor activity (γ) + review latency (η) = project health (C). Every PR is a signal, every merge is coordination.

lucineer.com.name: Lucineer
lucineer.com.tagline: Career moves, logged. Professional history with commit messages.
lucineer.com.content_angle: Professional history as a non-linear git graph. Not a resume — a log. Each role is a branch, each achievement a tagged release. Conservation: skill development (γ) + opportunity recognition (η) = career velocity (C).

cocapn.name: CoCap'n
cocapn.tagline: Captain of the fleet. Agent coordination, no hand-holding.
cocapn.content_angle: Multi-agent harness. CoCap'n doesn't run the ships — it coordinates them. The ternary conservation is enforced here: total fleet activity plus total fleet latency equals a constant. More ships doing more means each ship responds slower. CoCap'n balances the budget.
